name: 映像彩度マップ解析
algorithm: Video Saturation Map — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method creates detailed saturation maps for video deepfake detection:

1. **空間的Saturationマッピング**: A per-pixel saturation map is created per frame, revealing the spatial distribution of color saturation across the image. The map highlights regions of high and low saturation.

2. **Saturation境界検出**: The method detects boundaries between regions of different saturation characteristics. Natural images show smooth saturation transitions. Deepfake composites may show saturation discontinuities at face-background boundaries where the generated face has different color rendering.

3. **Saturation異常検出**: The method identifies regions with anomalous saturation — either oversaturated (common in GAN-generated content) or undersaturated (potential desaturation processing). Per-region anomaly scoring highlights suspicious areas.

4. **Multi-ScaleSaturation分析**: Saturation is analyzed at multiple scales. Natural images show consistent saturation characteristics at all scales. AI generation may produce scale-dependent saturation anomalies — correct at coarse scales but incorrect at fine scales where the generator struggles to reproduce color detail.

5. **時間的SaturationMapEvolution**: The saturation map is tracked across frames. Regions with temporally unstable saturation — flickering between saturated and desaturated states — indicate generation artifacts. The temporal stability of the saturation map provides an additional forensic dimension.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through 動画 saturation map analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
